A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new convolutional operator 3DN Conv that is invariant to scale and depth and we show that this new convolution can improve RGB D and RGB based semantic segmentation.
3DN Conv can be used as a general purpose operator to learn features from RGB D data and also can be used to learn depth from RGB data.
